desc: It is not the size of the dog in the fight that matters as much as the size of the fight in the dog! The Mini Leatherneck Series embodies this saying completely. Made from 8Cr13MoV steel and features a stainless steel guard with broad quillons to protect your fingers. The grip is made from Kray-Ex and is designed to be reminiscent of our larger Leatherneck models. These knives come with a tough, sturdy Secure-Ex sheath that will accommodate a bead lanyard or a Cold Steel C-Clip.
